qt: "A thief in the night, Draven did creep, families asleep, taken, held on high. Clever, he thought, 'til his children paid. Nay, villain, a man never bleeds alone."
"Beyond fire, blood, and nightmare, the Saviour will build Utopia."
"Captain Hiff Greybeard accomplished what nary a Brinerot could: he died of old age. Almost had him a dozen times meself, if it weren't for that damn leg of his... crafty shite..."
"I carry neither food nor drink. I rely on the charity of my fellow wayfarers. Dead men are generous men." - Taruk of the Wildmen
"I like my vassals at sword point, but my enemies as close as the hilt." - Emperor Chitus
"Move in ways your enemy does not expect. Confuse them with elegance and grace. They'll never see the axe coming." - Rakiata, Chieftain of the Tasalio Tribe
"Resist for long enough, and your oppressor will lose his will. Then, you've won."
"Sirrius flew on wings of light, faster than wind, faster than thought. But try as he might to outrun the darkness, it was there, at every turn, waiting for him." - Azmerian legend
"The ice seared his naked feet As the lightning stilled his heart, But it was the flames upon his lover's face That roused him to vengeance." - From 'The Three Dragons' by Victario of Sarn
"There is nowhere my vengeance cannot find you."
"What are you lot looking at? We're under fire! Get to your stations!" - Captain Sventura, the Unlucky
A faith born of flesh.
A flash of blue, a stormcloud's kiss, her motionless dance the pulse of bliss
A lightless world a silent reign two sightless eyes feed on your pain.
A power unknown aids your own.
A terror of ancient times, his identity remains lost... but his power does not.
A true predator does not chase; It waits.
A wall of steel and muscle.
A window onto a realm of red, where countless voices scream...
After the eruption, the skies turned grey, ash began to fall, and a chill set in...
All your tomorrows lie ahead of you, unknown and snarled to the very last.
As a boy, in the arena, Daresso learned to feign weakness to open up a lethal blow.
As the sun rises and the light approaches, so too shall your enemies fear you.
Banished for his tragic failure, Erian learned to hunt to survive.
Be not where death falls.
Beyond madness lies inspiration.
Blessed are those who tend the Grove.
Bloodshed on the crimson shores, longing for the endless sea. Treasures, life, I'd give it all just to capture thee.
Brinerot pirates live in a perpetual blaze of glory, pushing their luck right to the end.
Captivity breeds creativity.
Centuries of servitude, a day of glory, an eternity of death.
Clever artifice is not always complex.
Cold, miserable and alone... but alive.
Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke the night-blooming lotus of Middengard's stygian peaks, which grow only where ash meets the snow and stars.
Diamora sings not for hunger, but for longing.
Familiarity breeds contempt.
Fight with the ferocity of the First Ones.
For those noble families obsessed with keeping their bloodline pure, there was a price to pay...
From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born. From the carnage of Xibaqua, we were born. It is our duty to return to the gods what was once theirs.
Fueled by the blackness in the hearts of men, the armies of Saresh were just as relentless.
Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
He never spoke a word. His opponents imagined their own personal mockeries, most cruel.
His isolation caused him to treasure their companionship all the more.
In death, the legendary boar's tusks were turned to the slaying of Phaaryl's Eternal oppressors.
In its final era, the roofs of Keth were rife with anything and everything that could hold water... should the opportunity arise.
In the mists they dwell, forever hungry, forever cold.
It is safer to be feared than to be loved.
It was in this forsaken land, where mists shroud the world in mystery, that thieves, murderers, and outcasts, sought refuge.
Knowing she could outlast any opponent, Wrashmin fought not to win, but to delay.
Let the rider's aim be true.
Lift it lightly, don it slow. The spikes point out and in, you know.
Light and shadow chase eternal, but neither knows the other exists...
May you never hear it toll.
May your resolve never waver.
Natural decay can be twisted to dark ends.
No man burns alone.
Not the sound of thunder on the wind, but the rhoaback riders—death charging from the sands.
Obedience stretches beyond the grave.
Only once did Maligaro wonder if he'd gone too far. His greatest success took three entire legions to capture.
Only the High Priests could enact the sacrifices, but all who witnessed shared in exultation.
Praetor Draven knew his only chance to subjugate the Ezomytes was to catch them unaware.
Reality is a puzzle. Ingenuity is power.
Remaining unseen, the Dishonoured Assassin struck only in the depths of the harshest sandstorms.
Ride the western wind, and take flight.
Sinuous, entwined... inextricable.
Some search forever for their path.
Tale-women do not fight as dekharas. They command a power all their own.
Tempest's power given form, Flee before the walking storm.
That day, both the Unblinking Eye and their enemies stood in silence. That day, the sky was clear, but it was raining.
The Counts of Ogham share a legacy of cunning and power.
The beasts we fear the most are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
The cry of death whispers in the wind.
The devil finds work for idle hands.
The druids swore to protect the Grelwood with their very lives.
The druids walk the Grelwood without fear.
The gleam of the night and howling teeth alike could not abate the rising of the sun.
The greatest mistakes cause suffering long after they have been made
The older brother retained calm in the midst of fury.
The secret was lost with its maker.
The soul cannot flourish in a doubting mind.
The spirit hungers for the flesh.
The storm cannot sway those of sure footing.
The tale-women of old knew how to build anticipation.
The toughest armour is the trust of your people.
The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around. Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.
The whispers of the old gods hum through the iron. They demand a hero.
The younger brother waded into battle, shrugging off blows.
There is no safer place Than the Belly of the Beast
They screamed her name in adulation as they gave their very lives. She looked on with impatience.
To catch an animal, think like an animal.
Unlike the other gods, when he was born from the volcano, Valako rode the clouds of ash into the thundering sky.
We move to be closer to her, but the distance yet grows.
Welcome to Wraeclast.
What is worse, the sting of the past, the pain of the present, or the fear of the future?
When Solaris closes her burning eye At the end of time, the world will perish in ice.
When cornered and desperate, look within for the rage to break loose.
When the Red Sekhema called, the Ardura were the first to answer.
While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style, she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
Wraeclast has suffered many great disasters, but life always springs back anew.
